responsibility: Defines the x86 AVX-512 BITALG intrinsic interface for bit-algorithm operations such as per-element popcount and bit-shuffle mask generation. The header manages several feature combinations (plain BITALG, BITALG+BW, BITALG+VL, and BITALG+VL+BW) and exposes the corresponding masked and unmasked wrappers for vpopcount byte/word operations and vpshufbitqmb mask-producing instructions across 128-, 256-, and 512-bit forms.
